trap.label: so… that
trap.wrong: So strong that it was the wind.
trap.right: So strong was the wind that trees fell.
trap.why: Sem inversão e sem that a frase fica incompleta. So + adjetivo no início exige verbo antes do sujeito.

mcq.q: It is plain words ___ carry disagreement.
So strong ___ the wind that trees fell.
Such… that vs So… that: both mean…

opts: Such was noise that left we.
Such was the noise that we left.
Such the noise was we left.

fix.wrong: So strong the wind was that trees fell.
fix.right: So strong was the wind that trees fell.

fix.wrong: It is plain words what carry meaning.
fix.right: It is plain words that carry meaning.

fix.wrong: Such was the noise we left.
fix.right: Such was the noise that we left.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “The wind was so strong that trees fell.”
rewrite.answer: So strong was the wind that trees fell.
It is plain words that carry meaning.

rewrite.prompt: Com such: “The noise was so loud that we left.”
rewrite.answer: Such was the noise that we left.
